summary: Morpheus climbs into the cockpit and observes sentinels on the hologram radar. Trinity, standing behind him, asks how long they have. Morpheus estimates five to six minutes and orders Tank to charge the E.M.P. Trinity objects, stating the E.M.P. cannot be used until Neo is out, but Morpheus assures her that Neo will make it in time.

what_changes.before: Uncertain about the timing relative to Neo's exit
what_changes.after: Committed to using the E.M.P. within 5-6 minutes despite the risk to Neo

what_changes.before: Aware of the sentinels but not the specific timing
what_changes.after: Knows the E.M.P. must wait for Neo's extraction

event_hint.one_line: Morpheus and Trinity coordinate the timing of the E.M.P. deployment against incoming sentinels.
